intended_change: Run the same Dinomaly baseline on the user-repaired, globally exact-image-deduplicated Bridge512_balance dataset. Use its repaired original splits without additional filtering.

training.model_input: full image resized from 512x512 to 392x392; no center crop; same 28x28 token grid as the previous bridge run

validation.checkpoint_selection: maximum image AUROC; tie-break by pixel AP
validation.threshold_selection: maximum image F1 on validation scores

test.usage: after training only; primary validation-selected checkpoint and reference final-step checkpoint
test.threshold: fixed from validation for the corresponding checkpoint

metrics.mask_union: any nonzero RGB channel before interpolation
metrics.image_score: mean of top 1% smoothed anomaly-map pixels

original_data_changes: none by this experiment; use the dataset repaired by the user, with 6296 unique image byte hashes
comparison_limit: The dataset contents and test split differ from Bridge2893, so this is not a controlled improvement on the same test set.
publication_gate: Commit and push code, profiles and this plan; verify remote commit and clean matching server checkout; then launch.
